authority: Design plan mw_protocol_multi_agent_rearchitecture_design_20260809.md section 17.1, amended by the user-approved Plan v2 Task 1R.6 decision (2026-09-05): the default LLM and OCR/translation-support provider is the zhipu-coding-plan GLM-5.3-Flash profile on the official coding endpoint (https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4), with reasoning efforts low/high/max and default max. DeepSeek-v4-flash remains available only as the explicitly confirmed alternative profile recorded in role_registry.deepseek.json; it is never selected silently. This registry records the user-approved target profile only; it is credential-free and does not claim runtime readiness. Observed model identity belongs to a runtime ExecutionReservation receipt, never to registry text. The shared workload gate currently selects GLM-OCR-bf16 for OCR; the declared PaddleOCR role therefore remains fail-closed until gate/role policy reconciliation. OCR and translation declarations are unchanged by 1R.6.
